token_comparison.scope: previous vs production full INT3, 8 batches x 3 repeats x batch x 128 output tokens

limits: GS128 synthetic CUDA shape fails for both old tile16 and new tile32; new large CUDA tiles restricted to GS64.
FP16 baseline uses installed vLLM default Triton MoE without a shape-specific A100 tuning file.
Event profiles save the last prefill invocation per layer and batch, not all chunks; do not sum as whole-model TTFT.
Serial complete MoE replay includes shared branch, routed branch, activations and add; router/top-k input captured beforehand.
Tests use repeated prompt, not a traffic distribution or quality evaluation.
